title: Expedition Logbooks: Ocean Biome Reveal, Grand Expeditions and Where to Use Them
summary: An Expedition Logbook consumes on use to reveal an Ocean Biome section on the Atlas, each containing a Grand Expedition plus regular Expedition encounters. Current 0.5 logbooks come from Runic Monsters (Tier 10+ maps) and from Styrn, Fallen Knight of Aldur (guaranteed since 0.5.3). This guide covers where the reveal button appears, prerequisites, and what the old single-map Logbook flow used to be.
description: Where and how to use Expedition Logbooks in Path of Exile 2 0.5: Ocean Biome reveal on the Atlas, Grand Expeditions, Runic Monster and Styrn drops, and the disabled legacy Runic Splinter flow.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Path of Exile 2 Expedition Logbook item, an endgame Expedition key that reveals an Ocean Biome section with a Grand Expedition on the Atlas

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: Right-click an Expedition Logbook in your inventory to consume it and reveal an Ocean Biome section on the Atlas. Each revealed section contains a Grand Expedition (a full set of Expedition maps) plus regular Expedition encounters. Logbooks come from Runic Monsters in Tier 10+ maps and from Styrn, Fallen Knight of Aldur (guaranteed since 0.5.3). You must progress The Grand Expedition questline to Ruins of Kingsmarch before the Ocean Edge reveal button appears.
calloutDetail: The reveal happens on the Atlas at the Ocean Edge node, not in the old standalone Logbook map UI and not via a Realmgate.
Since 0.5.2 every revealed Ocean section guarantees at least one Grand Expedition; optionally activate a Saga in your bag first to modify the reveal.

answers.label: Use for
text: Revealing Ocean Biome sections to farm Grand Expeditions, runes, relics, Sagas, and to reach the Expedition pinnacle boss Olroth, Origin of the Fall.

answers.label: Check first
text: The Grand Expedition questline is progressed to Ruins of Kingsmarch, the Logbook is in your main inventory, and the Ocean Edge node is revealed on the Atlas.

answers.label: Avoid
text: Treating this like the old single-map Logbook or the Realmgate flow, and expecting Runic Splinters to do anything - Runic Splinters are disabled in 0.5.

sections.title: How to get an Expedition Logbook
intro: Logbooks are an endgame Expedition drop, not something you craft. There are three reliable ways to obtain one.

routes.label: Runic Monsters in Expedition encounters
body: Runic Monsters are the double red-flagpole enemies revealed by your explosives during an Expedition in Tier 10+ maps. The Logbook's level equals the map's Area Level, so a Tier 15 Waystone yields a level-79 Logbook (the threshold where the pinnacle boss Olroth can spawn). Corrupted or Irradiated maps add +1/+2 Area Level.

routes.label: Styrn, Fallen Knight of Aldur
body: Since 0.5.3, killing Styrn in the Tomb of the Fallen Knight sub-area always drops an Expedition Logbook. This is the most reliable, repeatable source and lets a level-79 mapping loop sustain itself on free Logbooks.

routes.label: Currency Exchange
body: Logbooks and artifacts trade on the Currency Exchange in the 'Expedition Coinage & Artifacts' row, which fills automatically. You can buy a stack and jump straight into running them without farming drops.

routes.label: Player trade
body: Because Logbooks are tradeable, you can also buy them directly from other players. Prices shift every league, so verify the live rate before committing a large stash.

sections.title: Where and how to use a Logbook

steps.label: Progress The Grand Expedition questline
body: Reach Ruins of Kingsmarch in the southeast of the Atlas during The Grand Expedition questline. The Ocean Edge reveal button does not appear until this questline is progressed.

steps.label: Keep the Logbook in your main inventory
body: The reveal consumes the Logbook from your person. It will not trigger from a stash, the Currency Exchange, or an Extra Inventory tab.

steps.label: Open the Atlas and find the Ocean Edge node
body: Once the questline is progressed and the Ocean Edge is revealed, that node shows a boat-shaped reveal button. This is the current 0.5 entry point - not the old standalone Logbook map or a Realmgate.

steps.label: Trigger the reveal
body: Interact with the Ocean Edge button to consume the Logbook. A section of ocean fog is cleared, revealing an Ocean Biome section with a Grand Expedition and regular Expedition encounters.

steps.label: Optionally activate a Saga first
body: Right-click a Saga in your bag before revealing to modify the revealed biome (for example, Aldur's Saga can improve Verisium Remnants). The Saga is a separate investment layer from the Logbook itself.

steps.label: Enter the Grand Expedition
body: Run the revealed maps: place explosive chains, wake Runic Monsters, and collect Remnant rewards. Higher-level Logbooks (level 79) give better modifier rolls and a chance at Olroth.

before: Before 0.5, a Logbook opened a single self-contained Expedition map; you carried it to a Logbook UI and it did not connect to a persistent ocean region.
after: In 0.5 the same item is consumed on the Atlas Ocean Edge to permanently reveal an Ocean Biome section that contains a Grand Expedition plus standard Expedition encounters.
compare.note: The 0.5 flow ties Logbooks into the Atlas fog and the Grand Expedition questline rather than a one-off map.

sections.title: Current 0.5 flow vs the legacy Logbook
paragraphs: In the current 0.5 (Runes of Aldur) endgame, an Expedition Logbook is consumed at the Atlas Ocean Edge to reveal an Ocean Biome section. That section always contains at least one Grand Expedition (since 0.5.2) alongside regular Expedition encounters, and it persists as part of your Atlas as you clear fog.

Older descriptions of Expedition access no longer apply. The pre-0.5 'single Logbook map' flow - where a Logbook simply opened one isolated Expedition map - has been replaced by the Atlas Ocean Biome system. Runic Splinters, which some older guides mention as an Expedition currency, are disabled in 0.5 and serve only as a historical reference. Likewise, any instruction to place a Logbook into a Realmgate is outdated for the current version.

Treat the boat-shaped Ocean Edge reveal button as the only current 0.5 entry point. If a guide tells you to open the Logbook through a hideout NPC or a Realmgate, it is describing legacy or conflicting information and should not be followed for 0.5.
bullets: Current 0.5: Logbook consumed at Atlas Ocean Edge -> reveals Ocean Biome section with a Grand Expedition.
Legacy: single self-contained Logbook map opened via old UI - no longer the 0.5 flow.
Runic Splinters: disabled in 0.5, historical only.
Realmgate instructions for Logbooks: outdated, do not follow for 0.5.

sections.title: What works in 0.5 vs what does not
note: Expedition Logbooks only function through the current 0.5 Atlas Ocean Edge flow. The older Expedition access items no longer function.

items.label: Questline progressed
checks: Confirm The Grand Expedition questline has reached Ruins of Kingsmarch in the southeast Atlas.
items.why: The Ocean Edge reveal button only appears after this questline is progressed.
items.fix: Run Expedition maps and follow the quest until Ruins of Kingsmarch is unlocked.

items.label: Logbook in main inventory
checks: The Logbook must be on your character, not in a stash or Extra Inventory tab.
items.why: The reveal consumes the item from your person.
items.fix: Move the Logbook into your main bag before opening the Atlas.

items.label: Right Logbook level for your goal
checks: If you want Olroth, use a level-79 Logbook (Tier 15 Waystone, or T13/T14 with Corrupted/Irradiated).
items.why: Olroth only spawns in high-level Logbooks; lower levels cap your reward ceiling.
items.fix: Run higher-tier maps or use +Area Level modifiers before farming.

items.label: Saga prepared (optional)
checks: If you plan to modify the reveal, right-click the Saga to activate it before triggering the Ocean Edge button.
items.why: A Saga is a separate investment layer and only applies if active when you reveal.
items.fix: Activate the Saga first; do not waste it on a weak reveal.

entries.question: I have a Logbook and a Saga - why can't I use it?
summary: A player had both items but saw no way to activate the Logbook.
editorialAnalysis: The reveal is gated by two things the player may have missed: The Grand Expedition questline must be progressed to Ruins of Kingsmarch, and the Logbook must be in the main inventory when the Atlas Ocean Edge node is viewed. A Saga is a separate modifier layer, not the trigger.
officialAnswer: Progress the questline, keep the Logbook in your bag, then use the Ocean Edge reveal button on the Atlas.

entries.question: I run lots of Expeditions in SSF but no Logbook drops - am I killing the wrong monster?
summary: Players confuse ordinary Expedition monsters with the actual Logbook source.
editorialAnalysis: Logbooks drop from Runic Monsters (the double red-flagpole enemies), not from every Expedition kill, and only in Tier 10+ maps. Below T10 you will not see Logbook drops. Styrn is the guaranteed fallback source.
officialAnswer: Target Runic Monsters in T10+ maps, or kill Styrn, Fallen Knight of Aldur, for a guaranteed Logbook.

entries.question: After the first Logbook, how does the boat button come back?
summary: Players finish the quest Logbook and cannot find a second reveal button.
editorialAnalysis: Each Logbook is consumed to reveal one Ocean section. The button reappears at the next Ocean Edge node as you clear fog and progress the questline; it is not a one-time quest object.
officialAnswer: Hold another Logbook in your bag and interact with the next revealed Ocean Edge node on the Atlas.

timestamps.label: Ocean Biome reveal on the Atlas

problems.symptom: The Ocean Edge reveal button does not appear
directAnswer: The button only shows after The Grand Expedition questline is progressed to Ruins of Kingsmarch and the Ocean Edge node is revealed. The Logbook must also be in your main inventory.
checks: Confirm questline progress, that the Logbook is in your bag (not stash), and that you are viewing the correct Ocean Edge node on the Atlas.

directAnswer: Logbooks only drop from Runic Monsters in Tier 10+ maps, or guaranteed from Styrn. Ordinary Expedition kills below T10 will not drop them.
checks: Run T10+ maps, target the double red-flagpole Runic Monsters, or kill Styrn in the Tomb of the Fallen Knight.

problems.symptom: I used a Logbook but saw no Grand Expedition
directAnswer: Since 0.5.2 every revealed Ocean section guarantees at least one Grand Expedition. If you only saw regular encounters, you may have triggered a normal map node rather than the Ocean Edge reveal.
checks: Use the Ocean Edge boat button on the Atlas, not any old Logbook map UI, and confirm the section revealed contains the Grand Expedition marker.
